meta.source: designed from scratch for the proposal & e-signature wireframe brief, 2026-09-18

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The app background behind everything. Never put a card of the same value on it — use surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, the editor canvas. The default ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: table headers, the quote panel, code and hash blocks, disabled fields.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and the variable picker. Pair with shadow-lg; in dark it is lighter than surface, in light only the shadow separates it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the rare inverted strip. Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The proposal document body and the signature pad. Deliberately identical in both themes: what the client reads must match the sealed PDF.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a dialog or the mobile signature step.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken and surface-raised. Both money totals are set in ink — never in a status colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface, surface-page and surface-sunken: timestamps, column labels, list prices beside an override, helper text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Document text and the drawn signature stroke on paper. Fixed in both themes, like paper itself.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper: footnotes, the consent paragraph, a list price beside an override inside the document.

tokens.name: paper-accent
tokens.usage: The tenant accent as it appears on paper — document links, the ticked-line marker, the focus ring inside the document. A workspace's accent must clear 4.5:1 on paper, because this one value also prints in the PDF and the emails.

tokens.name: paper-border
tokens.usage: Rules inside the document: pricing table lines, the signature block underline. Fixed like paper.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges — decoration only. Anything that carries meaning uses border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and toggle outlines, and any border that distinguishes a state. Holds 3:1 on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tenant chrome: primary buttons, links, the focus ring, selected rows. A workspace replaces this value. Never use it to carry a status.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of an accent fill or link.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a selected pricing line, an active nav item, or a ticked optional row. Carries accent or ink as text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. It flips with the theme — never hard-code white on a button.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline, drawn solid outside a 2px offset in the element's own ground so it stays visible on accent fills too.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in UI text and in the rendered document. Underlined; colour alone never marks a link.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Row background for a ticked optional line in the pricing table and for a selected list row.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed proposals, verified hashes, connected providers, a synced billing link. Text on surface or on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a success pill or banner. Carries success as text.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a solid success fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Anything waiting on a person: awaiting counter-signature, needs review, expiring soon, a stale revision, billing setup unfinished.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a warning pill or the stale-revision banner. Carries warning as text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a solid warning fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Declined proposals, failed jobs, a failed integrity check, destructive confirmation. Never used for an expired link, which is neutral.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a danger pill or an error banner. Carries danger as text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Movement without a decision: sent, viewed, a running job. A fixed product colour, distinct from the tenant accent on purpose.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a sent or viewed pill and for neutral informational banners. Carries info as text.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text on a solid info fill.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Only for work an assistant authored: the drafted-by-AI pill, the review banner, AI-entered prices, AI rows in the event trail.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the AI review banner and pill. Carries ai as text.

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Text on a solid ai fill.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a draft, archived or expired pill and for queued jobs. Carries ink-muted as text.

families.sans: Public Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
families.serif: Source Serif 4, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif
families.mono: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: ui-display
styles.usage: One per screen: the dashboard heading and the proposal record title.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Page and dialog titles below the display line.

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a card or panel.

styles.name: ui-subheading
styles.usage: Group headings inside a list or table.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Re-sending rotates the link, so the previous one stops working.
styles.usage: Default interface text, field values, table cells.

styles.name: ui-body-strong
styles.usage: The one phrase in a block that must be read first.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, secondary table columns.

styles.name: ui-small-strong
styles.usage: Status pill text and small emphasised labels.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Uppercase field and column labels. Set text-transform in CSS; the token does not.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Captions and the smallest metadata. Never for anything a decision depends on.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: The proposal title on the client page and page one of the PDF.

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: Top-level headings in the rendered document.

styles.name: doc-h2
styles.usage: Second-level headings in the rendered document.

styles.name: doc-h3
styles.usage: Third-level headings; the deepest level the editor offers.

styles.name: doc-lead
styles.sample: Prepared for Rowan Vale at Brightline Foods.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph only.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Each phase ends with a review you sign off before the next begins.
styles.usage: Document body copy. Sized for reading a long proposal on a phone — do not shrink it to fit more on screen.

styles.name: doc-small
styles.usage: Document footnotes and the consent paragraph.

styles.name: amount-display
styles.usage: The two totals in the sticky bar and the record header. Apply the .tnum class so digits align.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Subtotals and group totals.

styles.name: amount-md
styles.usage: Line amounts in the pricing table.

styles.name: amount-sm
styles.usage: The list price shown beside an overridden price, and price-schedule steps.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Content and PDF hashes, variable names, audit event types.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: IP, device and revision numbers in the audit trail. Never the only place a fact appears.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Steps 1 to 5 build a component; 6 and up separate regions.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a pill's icon and its word.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: an icon and its label, stacked pill rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control — between a checkbox and its text, between adjacent buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding and the gap between a field's label and its input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card and panel padding, and the gap between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards in a column, and the padding of a roomy panel such as the quote editor.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections within a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major regions, and the top margin of a document heading.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: The breathing room around an empty state or a completed-and-signed confirmation.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes and the smallest chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, table row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, banners, the document container.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the signature pad, the mobile sticky bar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The client-facing document card on a wide screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the source badge. Nothing else.

shadow.note: Elevation is scarce: a proposal is a document, not a dashboard of floating cards.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting buttons and the sticky table header.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the variable picker.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile signature sheet, over overlay.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The document card on paper. The only shadow allowed on a client page.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Upward shadow on the sticky totals bar, so the document reads as passing beneath it.

size.note: Control heights and the two layout measures.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense internal table controls only. Never on a client page.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default internal control height: buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Every interactive target on a client page, and the primary action anywhere.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Accept & sign, and the billing hand-off button.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything a client taps, including an optional-line checkbox.

tokens.name: measure-doc
tokens.usage: Maximum width of document body copy, so a line stays readable.

tokens.name: measure-app
tokens.usage: Maximum width of an internal page's content column.

tokens.name: measure-form
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a single-column form such as login or the password gate.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside pills, buttons and table cells.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in banners and nav.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: The icon in an empty state or a confirmation screen.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-thick
tokens.usage: The focus ring, a selected tab's underline, a checked checkbox.

tokens.name: stroke-signature
tokens.usage: The drawn signature stroke on the pad, in paper-ink.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control. Never the only signal — pair it with the reason in text.

tokens.name: opacity-frozen
tokens.usage: Signed content and locked checkboxes, which stay readable but cannot be changed.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the internal app header.

tokens.name: z-bar
tokens.usage: The client page's totals and Accept & sign bar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The scrim.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the signature sheet.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Autosave and retry confirmations.
